rows.ARS:
Light yellow Shrub.
Exhibition name: Morning Star
rows.Origin:
Bred by Mike Athy (New Zealand, before 2012).
Introduced in South Africa by Ludwig's Roses in 2012 as 'Morning Star'.
rows.Bloom: Light yellow. Large, double (17-25 petals) bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Growing: Can be used for cut flower or specimen.
rows.Parentage: If you know the parentage of this rose, or other details, please contact us.
